summary_en: By decree Misericordia eius, at the mandate of Pope Francis, the name of Saint Maria Faustina (Helena) Kowalska, virgin, is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar and her optional memorial is to be celebrated by all on 5 October; the new memorial is to be inserted in every Calendar and liturgical book for Mass and the Liturgy of the Hours. The Latin decree (pp. 89-90) is followed by English, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese versions (pp. 91-96) and by the annexed additions to the Calendar, Missal, Ordo lectionum, Liturgy of the Hours and Martyrology (pp. 97-101, including a new elogium in first place on 5 October).
excerpt: decrevit, ut nomen sanctæ Mariæ Faustinæ (Helenæ) Kowalska, virginis, in Calendario Romano generali inscriberetur et eius memoria ad libitum quotannis die 5 mensis Octobris ab omnibus celebraretur.

summary_en: One-year ruling for the year 2022 only (Responsum ad dubia de Calendario liturgico exarando pro anno 2022, 11 May 2020, no protocol number printed): (a) Mary Mother of God, Saturday 1 January, and the Second Sunday after the Nativity, 2 January: on 1 January II Vespers and the evening Mass are of the solemnity; (b) St Joseph, Saturday 19 March, and the Third Sunday of Lent, 20 March: on 19 March I Vespers and the evening Mass are of the Sunday; (c) the Nativity of St John the Baptist and the Sacred Heart both falling on Friday 24 June: the Sacred Heart is celebrated on 24 June and the Nativity of St John the Baptist is transferred to Thursday 23 June with its II Vespers omitted and I Vespers of the Sacred Heart celebrated, but where St John the Baptist is patron of the nation, diocese, city or religious community, his Nativity is kept on Friday 24 June and the Sacred Heart is transferred to Thursday 23 June up to and including None; (d) Twentieth Sunday in Ordinary Time, 14 August, and the Assumption, Monday 15 August: on 14 August I Vespers and the Vigil Mass of the Assumption are celebrated.
excerpt: Sollemnitas Nativitatis S. Ioannis Baptistæ et sollemnitas Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu, eadem die 24 iunii coincidentes. – Die 24 iunii, feria VI: sollemnitas Sacratissimi Cordis Iesu celebretur. Sollemnitas Nativitatis S. Ioannis Baptistae ad diem 23 iunii, feriam V, transferatur, II Vesperæ omittantur.
